176.news_title: Arcooda 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitors Now with Integrated Speakers
176.long_description:
We have recently released our 21.3inch and 35inch Arcooda monitors with built in integrated speaker solutions. These LCD monitors are highly suitable for digital display and home users looking for a complete visual and audio multimedia experience. Key Benefits
  • Built-in stereo speakers – no external speakers required.
  • Cleaner installations with reduced cable clutter.
  • Ideal for space-constrained applications where every centimetre matters.
  • Perfect for kiosks, industrial systems, digital signage, retro gaming, arcade machines, and commercial displays.
  • Professional appearance with all audio contained within the monitor.
    • The integrated speaker option complements the features our customers already rely on, including the true 4:3 aspect ratio, IPS display technology, multiple video inputs (HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI and VGA). These monitors continue to deliver the performance required for both legacy systems and modern applications but now with integrated speakers. Whether you're designing a new product, upgrading existing equipment, or building a complete display solution, the addition of integrated speakers makes our 4:3 monitors even more flexible. There are 2 audio solutions; 1) connect your HDMI and DisplayPort cable to our monitor 2) connect audio source via the 3.5mm audio jack in our monitor then, use the monitor's menu system (via remote control or OSD button board) to control your audio level via the monitor's speakers. Mute the audio also via the mute button. If you're looking for a professional 4:3 monitor with integrated audio via dual speaker system, explore the latest Arcooda range and discover a simpler, more complete display solution.
